scientific_claim_boundary: RhlA hidden truth has already been revealed in a prior experiment. This experiment develops and audits an acquisition controller retrospectively; it is not fresh prospective validation.

initial_state.selection: exact same deterministic 5% membership frozen in the prior RhlA sample-efficiency experiment

controller.type: external acquisition controller above frozen NABU V8.3
controller.round_policy: 50 percent structural exploration plus 50 percent V8.3 exploitation by rank fusion
controller.structural_exploration: For each unmeasured candidate, compute mean support deficit over its main effects and pair subsets: deficit=1/sqrt(1+support). Higher is more exploratory.
controller.exploitation: Score candidates using the current frozen V8.3 model and its current OOF-selected router mode. Unscoreable candidates receive the lowest exploitation rank, not synthetic fitness.

evaluation.fixed_hidden_pool: exact same 540 hidden triple-mutant candidates frozen in prior RhlA test
comparison: active budget vs same-size prior passive budget
active budget vs frozen passive 40% reference

target_question: Can active 10% or 20% reach the practical threshold previously requiring passive 40%?

anti_leakage_simulation.stage_A: Start from prior frozen 5% labels. At each round the selector receives candidate identities plus the current fitted model only, freezes selected IDs and acquisition scores, then reveals labels for those selected IDs from TRAINING_POOL.csv to fit the next round. Hidden-test truth is never loaded.
anti_leakage_simulation.stage_B: Verify Stage-A hashes, then load the same sealed hidden-triple truth and compare active budgets to frozen prior passive metrics.
